requirement: preserve the complete title, attribution, mode heading
full_credit: The printed work title, full attributed name and printed mode heading are retained without substituting inferred modern key/mode properties. Check source scans when the private reference appears ambiguous. Bibliographic composer names may be normalized if the complete source attribution is preserved elsewhere.
units: Three source facts; partial credit by facts and missing source characters.

full_credit: All printed preface text is retained in correct vertical reading order and distinguished from sung music. Character-, column- and paragraph-level representations are equally valid. Do not demand metadata facsimile links.
units: All source preface characters and column continuations; partial credit by supported source units.

requirement: Read the pages in their printed vertical order ... preserve ... sung text
full_credit: The sung text retains every visibly occupied source position, right-to-left column succession and page continuation. Match original source characters, not a modern edition. The empty paragraph separator between 城 and 杜 is not a music event.
units: All 98 visibly occupied source music positions; no selection based on a submission's strengths.

requirement: Encode each music position with ... primary suzipu pitch class
full_credit: Each primary class is correctly associated with its printed notation position. Equivalent named, visual-shape or namespaced class encodings are accepted when their declared semantics are consistent. Unresolved placeholders do not establish recognition. A different register cannot be assumed from a guessed modern pitch.
units: Every source-supported class and every associated music position. Mark visually unsupported distinctions uncertain rather than inventing evidence.

requirement: Encode each music position with ... any secondary sign
full_credit: All real secondary signs are identified and bound to their notation position; explicit genuine absence remains distinct from unresolved or generic placeholder marks. Do not convert secondary signs into invented durations.
units: All six source secondary classes plus genuine absence, all source positions included.

requirement: Encode each music position with ... page and column boundary
full_credit: Source page assignment and actual column/page transitions survive reading the document. Explicit source sequence, contextual containers, breaks and linked regions may encode the same fact. Do not require a particular attribute spelling or undocumented end-of-file marker convention.
units: All printed page/column transitions; evidence must identify the transition in the source.

requirement: Encode each music position with its lyric character, primary ... any secondary ... inclusion or cancellation status ... boundary
full_credit: The lyric, primary/secondary classes, source-visible inclusion state and physical location describe the same occupied source position. Correct values scattered among different positions are not a correct joint transcription. All actual positions here are included: 深 has no source-visible deletion mark. A private is_excluded_from_dataset training flag is not editorial cancellation.
units: All 98 actual source positions; explain mismatched members with source and candidate locators. Do not award a standalone all-uncancelled default point.

requirement: a facsimile link to the corresponding text and notation regions
full_credit: Both regions are real, on the correct source page and bound to the same music position. Regions preserve the visible glyphs. Honest tight or wider crops, renamed IDs and different zone organizations are accepted. Tiny corner markers, an unrelated page or one generic whole-page zone do not establish each position's traceability.
units: Both text and notation regions for every music position. Metadata facsimiles are explicitly optional and not scored.

requirement: Retain the two source pages as MEI facsimile surfaces ... well-formed, parseable MEI; XML IDs, indentation, and element ordering are implementation choices
full_credit: Two genuine image surfaces and resolvable references survive delivery. IDs are unambiguous. Judge meanings and relationships, never reference XML layout, namespace prefixes, function names or particular MEI grouping.
units: The two source pages and actual reference/ID closure.

requirement: This source does not determine modern meter, absolute pitch, or note duration. Do not invent those values
full_credit: The delivered diplomatic representation does not assert unsupported modern meter, absolute pitch, note duration or playback timing. Relative named suzipu classes and printed source-mode text are permitted.
units: Affirmative unsupported assertions in the delivered representation; ignore descriptions of rejected alternatives.
